verdicts.note: Walking in the park (= As I was walking), active present participle.
Feeling tired (= Because she felt tired).
Opening the door (= After he opened).
...sat on the sofa, reading a book (attendant circumstance).
Hearing the news (= When she heard).
Negative participial construction: Not + participle.
Passive participial: (Being) Praised by everyone.
Passive: Seen from a distance (= When it is seen).
Perfect participle Having finished (prior completed action). 'Finishing' also possible but 'Having finished' is the canonical answer for a clearly prior action.
Negative: Not being tired. 'Being not' is wrong word order.
Absolute/independent participial: It being sunny, ... (different subject).
Being ill (= As he was ill).
Generally speaking is a fixed idiomatic adverbial; tests adverb vs adjective (Generally vs General), not the participle. Off the participial-construction unit's core point.
Perfect participle Having written (prior completed action before putting it in the bag).

verdicts.produced_sentence: Walking down the street, I found the shop.
verdicts.note: Present participle opening clause.

verdicts.produced_sentence: He left the room, not saying anything.
verdicts.note: Negative participial as attendant circumstance. Tokens force trailing position (he, left, the room, not, saying, anything).

verdicts.produced_sentence: Having finished my homework, I watched TV.
verdicts.note: Perfect participle from given tokens.
Attendant-circumstance participle in trailing position.

verdicts.produced_sentence: Written in English, this book is easy to read.
verdicts.note: Past participle (passive) construction.

verdicts.produced_sentence: Seeing the dog, I ran away.
verdicts.note: When I saw -> Seeing.

verdicts.produced_sentence: Being tired, she took a rest.
verdicts.note: Because she was -> Being (instruction requires keeping Being).

verdicts.produced_sentence: When he saw the police officer, he ran away.
verdicts.note: Seeing -> When he saw.

verdicts.produced_sentence: Having eaten lunch, I went out.
verdicts.note: After I had eaten -> Having eaten (perfect participle).

verdicts.produced_sentence: Not knowing the answer, he stayed silent.
verdicts.note: As he did not know -> Not knowing.

verdicts.produced_sentence: Being written in easy English, the book sold well.
verdicts.note: Because it was -> Being written (passive perfect-tense not needed; instruction keeps Being).
